strings.supportBody: Even if it feels as though nobody understands, there are people who want to listen. You can call 116123 — it is one six-digit number (yes, only six digits). The call is free, and support is available around the clock in Latvian, English and Russian. The service follows principles of anonymity and confidentiality and does not notify your family, friends or workplace. Someone with access to your phone or bill may be able to see that you called. You do not need to prepare what to say; you can simply say: “I’m having a hard time.”
strings.emergencyBody: If you or someone else is in immediate danger, call 112 for emergency assistance. The support line does not replace emergency help.
strings.guideBody: Open the downloaded HTML file in your browser; a file preview cannot run it. Answers stay only in the open questionnaire. To continue later, choose “Save progress to file”, then “Resume from file”. The saved file contains your answers, so check it before sharing. You choose what to discuss with a clinician.

strings.legalBody:
The questionnaire works offline, uses no analytics, and does not automatically send answers anywhere. Answers remain in the open questionnaire and are lost when you close it unless you save a progress file. That file is not encrypted and may contain sensitive health answers, so store and share it carefully.

Question feedback is copied separately and does not include medical answers. Do not put your name or other personal details in comments.

This build is for technical professional review. It is not clinically validated and does not diagnose.
